question: List Breast Chemotherapy trials where overall follow‑up exceeded 21 months.

gemini.answer: This SQL query retrieves the NCT ID, authors, publication year and PubMed ID for clinical trials related to breast cancer that involve chemotherapy and have an overall follow-up duration exceeding 21 months.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%Breast%' AND \"treatment_regimen\" ILIKE '%Chemo%' AND \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\" > 21",
  "answer": "This SQL query retrieves the NCT ID, authors, publication year and PubMed ID for clinical trials related to breast cancer that involve chemotherapy and have an overall follow-up duration exceeding 21 months.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
